title: A weighted integral on a parabolic arc
measure: Normalized H^1 restricted to C; L^1 on [0,1]; H^1 agrees with length, H^0 counts points.
hypotheses: gamma(t)=(t,t^2) for 0<=t<=1 is injective and Lipschitz; f(x,y)=x is nonnegative continuous on C.

title: Traversing a circle twice: multiplicity and orientation
measure: Normalized H^1 restricted to the unit circle; L^1 on [0,4pi]; H^0 counts parameter preimages.
hypotheses: gamma(t)=(cos(t),sin(t)) on [0,4pi] is Lipschitz; w(x,y)=x^2 is continuous nonnegative; multiplicity is two except at (1,0), where it is three.
result: Integral_C x^2 dH^1=pi; parameter integral over two traversals=2pi; F=(-y,x) has circulation 4pi over two counterclockwise traversals and 2pi once; outward flux of G=(x,y) is 2pi.

title: Height integral over a paraboloid graph
measure: Normalized H^2 restricted to S; L^2 on the closed unit disk; normalized H^2 equals plane area on 2-planes.
hypotheses: Phi(x,y)=(x,y,x^2+y^2) on the closed unit disk is injective and sqrt(5)-Lipschitz; height h=z is bounded continuous nonnegative on S.
result: Integral_S z dH^2=pi(25 sqrt(5)+1)/60; H^2(S)=pi(5 sqrt(5)-1)/6.

title: A sphere's second moment and a spherical cap
measure: Normalized H^2 restricted to sphere S_R; L^2 on the angular rectangle; H^2 equals surface area.
hypotheses: R>0; spherical map is injective on (0,pi) x (0,2pi), with bounded derivatives; omitted meridian has H^2 measure zero; h=z^2 is continuous and bounded.
result: Integral_(S_R) z^2 dH^2=4pi R^4/3; H^2(S_R)=4pi R^2; cap of height a in [0,2R] has area 2pi R a; outward flux of G(q)=q is 4pi R^3.
